text: Healthy living is about more than just eating well; it is a complete approach to caring for your body and mind. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives you the energy to get through the day. Regular exercise, even a simple daily walk, strengthens your heart and improves your mood. Equally important is getting enough sleep, usually seven to nine hours, so your body can recover and your mind can rest. However, we often forget about mental health. Taking time to relax, practicing mindfulness, or talking to friends helps reduce stress. Finally, a healthy work-life balance means setting boundaries and making time for hobbies and family, preventing burnout and keeping you happy.
